purpose: A carrier can bootstrap the active canonical Origami visual profile, its concrete ROSETTA bindings and bounded micro-machine while remaining usable through prompt/native perception and optionally enhanced by deterministic computation or Hybrid tools.

carrier_sections.role: entry point, canonical profile/version discovery, section discovery, start state and execution hints
self-description of canonical profile/version, active dimensions, visual-token to semantic-role bindings and reveal procedures where required
deterministic micro-agent or micro-automata transition rules
proof references, checks, semantic roundtrip and exactness boundaries
explicit irreducible information; never a hidden escape hatch

modes.native: BOOT + ROSETTA + PROGRAM + INDEX + MEMORY are interpreted from one visual carrier by a model with no undeclared decoder or required external runtime.
modes.computational: An explicitly available deterministic Origami runtime exposes bounded operations without requiring visual low-level decoding.
modes.hybrid: The model uses the carrier for bootstrap/high-level navigation and delegates exact/local mechanical work to explicitly declared tools/runtime. Hybrid is a performance target, not the minimum compatibility requirement.
modes.write: The model/source pipeline emits a semantic/construction specification bound to the canonical visual profile; when a deterministic compiler is actually available it creates and roundtrip-verifies the carrier; otherwise the model returns CONSTRUCTION_SPEC_ONLY.

anti_shortcuts: Do not encode the source as a plaintext screenshot/poster.
Do not invent a private aesthetic for each carrier/document.
Do not remove ROSETTA merely because the profile is known.
Do not require the external prompt to contain private carrier bindings.
Do not hide a full-memory scan behind a compact model-facing answer.
Do not let the model silently perform semantics absent from the carrier/runtime.
Do not report a semantic reconstruction as byte-exact without verification.
Do not report a tool-assisted result as evidence that prompt-only/native operation succeeded.
cross_model_test: Keep the external Master Prompt and canonical profile version fixed while varying target models and document semantics. Evaluate prompt/native and Hybrid/tool-assisted capabilities separately. Correct behavior must follow BOOT/ROSETTA and preserve the canonical aesthetic; future aesthetic revisions require explicit Origami profile-version promotion rather than per-carrier drift.
